name: NEXTDC M2 Melbourne Stage 5

lat.note: Same point as nextdc-m2 (geocoded 2026-09-27 from '75 Sharps Road, Tullamarine VIC 3043', ArcGIS PointAddress score 100); the stage's own building footprint on the site was not located

builder.note: head contractor; architects VIA Architects and HDR, PM APP Corporation (source 2)

mw_it.note: 'added an additional 3750m2 of technical space and 15MW to the 60MW M2 facility' (five data halls, rack-ready fit-out). Kapitol also lists separate 'Stage 5 Expansion Works' (design and build of several data halls, due July 2024, MW not stated); not included here and not given a row. Building/phase within the NEXTDC M2 campus; stage 1 is nextdc-m2; other stages: nextdc-m2-stage2, nextdc-m2-stage4, nextdc-m2-stage5, nextdc-m2-stage6, nextdc-m2-stage9-11.

authority.note: 75 Sharps Rd is in the City of Brimbank (Brimbank register; PlanningAlerts P341/2022), not Hume as earlier assumed

pathway.value: council planning permit (Planning and Environment Act 1987)

reference.note: site data centre permit; no separate permit for stage 5 in the Brimbank register (Dec 2018 onward), so presumably under P589/2016 as granted/amended before Dec 2018 (inference)

construction_start.note: not stated; Kapitol: 'delivered in a tight, 11-month programme', which with PC in March 2022 implies ~April 2021 (inference only). FY21 AR (Aug 2021) STI target: 'expansion works for Stage 3 & 5' (source 4)

construction_end.note: 'M2 stage 5 reached practical completion in March 2022' (Kapitol news April 2022, source 2)

open_questions: construction start date not stated (11-month programme implies ~Apr 2021)
relationship of Kapitol 'Stage 5 Expansion Works' (fit-out, due Jul 2024, MW unstated) to this row
